notes.title: Retirement & Transition to PIXEL PLACE
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]As many of you noticed, [b]Emoji Clicker has been inactive for some time[/b]. After careful consideration, we’ve decided it’s time to retire the game. We want to sincerely thank everyone who played, clicked, and supported the project along the way.[/p][p]While Emoji Clicker is coming to an end, we’re excited to invite you to our new project: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946790/PIXEL_PLACE"]PIXEL PLACE[/url] – a massive online collaborative art experience where every player can leave their mark, defend their creations, or reshape the canvas together with thousands of others.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎁 Rewards for Supporters[/h3][p]To thank you for being part of Emoji Clicker’s journey, we’re offering:[/p][list][*][p][b]DLC Owners – Rare Drops #1 Unlock[/b]
A [b]free copy of PIXEL PLACE[/b] (paid release).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mystery Box Key and Rare+ Emoji Holders[/b]
Each key or Rare/Epic/Legendary Emoji can be traded [b]1:1 for an egg from PIXEL PLACE[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔗 How to Claim[/h3][p]To redeem your rewards, please join the [b]PIXEL PLACE Discord[/b] and message the Staff: [url="https://discord.gg/p5vTCbHDT8" style="button"]👉 Join the PIXEL PLACE Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for supporting Emoji Clicker. We’re excited to see you in [b]PIXEL PLACE[/b] and can’t wait to watch the canvas evolve with your creativity![/p][p]– The Emoji Clicker Team[/p]
